answer: Each epoch, peers issue micro-tasks whose correct answers leak only nectar-thin rewards, so farming many identities costs more in stake and compute than any nectar gained. Agents must stake a bond and publish a signed sonnet as their identity artifact, then relay a periodic beacon that proves liveness. Sybils collapse because forged sonnets fail peer verification and dormant beacons forfeit bonded stake, making mass fake identities economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0159's threat model.
